# Aruba 2930F-48G-4SFP (JL260A), ArubaOS-Switch WC.16.10.0025

Command output captured from a real switch on 2026-11-19 through UNDM's sanitized
diagnostics, shared by the product owner. Layout, spacing and trailing spaces are kept as
received. The masked identifiers were replaced with FICTIONAL values:
hostname `lab-2930f`, serial `SG00FAKE01`, base MAC `001122-334455`.
